steps.say: Once a subject is found, the buttons at the bottom of the panel produce the images and files that go into a report. This video shows Capture Map, the overall location map, the Addenda Pack and parcel snapshots.

Capture Map renders the current view at 1950 by 1050 pixels, which is six and a half by three and a half inches at 300 d p i, the size of a report figure. Turn on zoning first and the legend can be included.
Tick Include legend and the scale bar and north arrow. Copy image puts it on the clipboard for pasting straight into Word. Download P N G or J P G saves a file.
Alt C is the shortcut. It copies the current map view to the clipboard with no dialog at all.

M B Overall Map draws the province location map with a subject callout. Change the callout text, move the arrow to any side, and switch to the Winnipeg base for city subjects. Copy or download the image.

Addenda Pack builds the whole set in one click. A location map, a neighbourhood map framed on the municipality with the section grid and highways, a subject aerial with dimensions, a zoning map, and an all-results map when there are several parcels.
The button reports progress as each map renders. The map view is restored when it finishes, and the zip downloads with a readme listing what is inside. That is the report set for a single subject.
